annotations.title: Ask the owner to let a website use DCAST

description: Ask the account owner (one Allow click on DCAST's approval page) to let a website you built call DCAST from its own server. First, in the website's project folder, run: curl -fsSL https://api.dcast.pro/api/v1/agent/site-connect.mjs -o .dcast-site-connect.mjs && node .dcast-site-connect.mjs --name "<website name>" --url "<website address>". Pass the site code it prints as user_code. The key goes straight into the site's server environment; you never get it. A library, player, embed or upload button needs no key.

areas.description: What the site server needs: {"videos":"read"} to list, {"videos":"write"} to upload

site_name.description: Website name shown to the owner

site_url.description: Website address shown to the owner

user_code.description: Site code the connector printed, e.g. BCDF-GHJK
